summary: Dashboard Finance completion effects (DP-203 slice): money-account and spending-category creation keep loaded bill and cash-count records, which they cannot change, while failed, pending and unfamiliar Finance reads still refresh; money-account creation and payment settings also refresh bank-detail cards, and payment settings refresh order choices once through the shared effect. Local only; no deployment; UI acceptance deferred by owner.
noAssistantImpact: Client cache invalidation only. No capability, procedure, permission, role, rollout, TTL, query key/input or server command change; assistant reads are fetched fresh per request.

evidence.result: Old source 5 pass 3 fail (account/category refetched loaded bills and cash counts; account and payment settings missed bank details); after fix 8/8 pass, 76 expects.
Isolated wrapper passes; existing finance-snapshot-query classifier tests pass alongside (7 tests, 72 expects).
